items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee responds to the interviewer's description of James Talbert ('Jimmy') with 'That's funny. Unemployment checks were about $18 a week.' The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with Talbert, but rather comments on the financial detail mentioned by the interviewer regarding

ctx.x: But anyhow, I don't know how we got off into that.

We were talking about the sessions... Well, first you were talking about Norman Granz' beginnings as a promoter in Normandie Hall, which later the Four Brothers presented concerts there in the early Fifties, the Four Brothers not being Herman's Four Brothers, but James Talbert, Irving Ashby... Remember those sessions?
Oh yeah. You're talking about Normandie Hall again.
